exposure: World Health Organization (WHO) classification of heart disease
outcome: Cardiovascular events during pregnancy and puerperium
finding: Neonatal birth weights were significantly lower and preterm delivery rates were higher in women with WHO Class III heart disease compared to other classes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed due to cardiac indications in high-risk classes, while obstetric indications were considered in low-risk classes.
gest_age: Preterm delivery rate was higher in Class III heart disease.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was significantly lower in women with Class III heart disease compared to other classes.
